ei.subject: 영어1
ei.title: A Rooftop Garden in Sejong City

fullPassage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help reduce energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants give off oxygen and absorb air pollutants. One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to complement the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere. It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and captivating views to enjoy. The place is free to visit, and everyone is welcome to enjoy the beautiful landscape and aesthetic spectacle of Sejong City from above.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural (A)[oasis / desert]. These gardens are for (B)[cultivating / removing] plants on building roofs, and they offer (C)[numerous / limited] benefits.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 옥상 정원은 자연의 오아시스(oasis)를 제공한다. 건물 옥상에서 식물을 재배(cultivating)하며, 수많은(numerous) 혜택을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① oasis — cultivating — numerous: 원문 일치.
❌ ② desert(사막): oasis의 반의어.
❌ ③ removing(제거): cultivating의 반의어.
❌ ④ limited(제한된): numerous의 반의어.
det.tip: oasis(오아시스) ↔ desert(사막), cultivating(재배) ↔ removing(제거), numerous(수많은) ↔ limited(제한된)

questions.passage: They help (A)[reduce / increase] energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants give off oxygen and (B)[absorb / release] air pollutants. One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially (C)[recognized / ignored] as the largest of its kind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 에너지 소비를 줄이고(reduce), 대기 오염물질을 흡수(absorb)하며, 최대 규모로 공식 인정(recognized)받았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ reduce — absorb — recognized: 원문 일치.
❌ ① release(방출): absorb의 반의어.
❌ ② increase(증가): reduce의 반의어.
❌ ④ ignored(무시된): recognized의 반의어.
det.tip: reduce(줄이다) ↔ increase(늘리다), absorb(흡수) ↔ release(방출), recognized(인정된) ↔ ignored(무시된)

questions.passage: The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to (A)[complement / contradict] the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere. It also possesses an (B)[impressive / insignificant] variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and (C)[captivating / repelling] views to enjoy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 식물을 보완(complement)하고, 인상적인(impressive) 다양한 꽃이 있으며, 매혹적인(captivating) 경치를 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② complement — impressive — captivating: 원문 일치.
❌ ① insignificant(하찮은): impressive의 반의어.
❌ ③ contradict(모순되다): complement의 반의어.
❌ ④ repelling(혐오감을 주는): captivating의 반의어.
det.tip: complement(보완하다) ↔ contradict(모순되다), impressive(인상적인) ↔ insignificant(하찮은)

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous ①<u>benefits</u>. They help reduce energy ②<u>consumption</u> for heating and cooling. They also ③<u>pollute</u> the air because their plants give off oxygen and ④<u>absorb</u> air pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③pollute(오염시키다) → clean(정화하다): 식물이 산소를 내뿜고 오염물질을 흡수하므로 '정화'가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ pollute → clean: 산소 배출+오염물질 흡수 = 정화.
❌ ① benefits(혜택): 적절.
❌ ② consumption(소비): 에너지 소비 적절.
det.tip: clean(정화하다) ↔ pollute(오염시키다).

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen ①<u>connected</u> buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural ②<u>drainage</u> effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to ③<u>complement</u> the plants. It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 ④<u>identical</u> plant species.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ identical → different: '192 different plant species' 원문.
❌ ① connected(연결된): 15개 연결 건물 적절.
❌ ② drainage(배수): 현무암의 배수 효과 적절.
❌ ③ complement(보완하다): 식물과 어울리도록 적절.
det.tip: different(다른) ↔ identical(동일한). 192종의 다양한 식물.

questions.passage: The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and captivating views to enjoy. The place is ①<u>free</u> to visit, and everyone is ②<u>welcome</u> to enjoy the beautiful landscape and ③<u>aesthetic</u> spectacle of Sejong City from ④<u>below</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 의미가 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ below → above: 옥상(rooftop)에서 보는 것이므로 'from above'.
❌ ① free(무료의): 무료 방문 적절.
❌ ② welcome(환영받는): 누구나 환영 적절.
❌ ③ aesthetic(미적인): 아름다운 장관 적절.
det.tip: above(위에서) ↔ below(아래에서). rooftop = 건물 옥상 → 위에서 본다.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural __________. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help reduce energy consumption for heating and cooling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 도시 콘크리트 속에서 옥상 정원은 자연의 오아시스(oasis)를 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ oasis: 콘크리트 도시 속 자연 녹지.
❌ ① barrier(장벽): 정원은 장벽이 아님.
❌ ② hazard(위험): 정원은 위험하지 않음.
❌ ③ obstacle(장애물): 정원은 장애물이 아님.
det.tip: oasis(오아시스): 사막/도시 속 쉼터. 비유적 표현.

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural __________ effect.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ drainage: 현무암의 다공성 → 배수 효과.
❌ ① irrigation(관개): 물을 공급하는 것과 다름.
❌ ② insulation(단열): 현무암은 단열보다 배수.
❌ ④ pollution(오염): 오염 효과는 부적절.
det.tip: drainage(배수): 물이 빠지는 효과. basalt(현무암)의 자연 배수 기능.

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to complement the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere. It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each passing season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and __________ views to enjoy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① captivating: 아름다운 분위기+192종 식물 → 매혹적.
❌ ② disturbing(불안한): 아름다운 분위기와 반대.
❌ ③ monotonous(단조로운): 계절마다 변하므로 반대.
❌ ④ fading(사라지는): 경치가 사라진다는 것은 부적절.
det.tip: captivating(매혹적인) ≈ fascinating. 'captivating views' = 매혹적인 경치.

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially <u>recognized</u> as the largest of its kind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'recognized'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② acknowledged: recognized와 동의어.
❌ ① rejected(거부된): 반의어.
❌ ③ criticized(비판된): 다른 의미.
❌ ④ overlooked(간과된): 반의어.
det.tip: recognize ≈ acknowledge(인정하다).

questions.passage: These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help <u>reduce</u> energy consumption for heating and cooling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'reduce'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ decrease: reduce와 동의어.
❌ ① increase(늘리다): 반의어.
❌ ② maintain(유지하다): 다른 의미.
❌ ④ generate(생성하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: reduce ≈ decrease ≈ lower(줄이다).

questions.passage: In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to <u>complement</u> the plants, creating a beautiful atmosphere.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'complement'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ go well with: complement와 유사.
❌ ① replace(대체하다): 다른 의미.
❌ ② contradict(모순되다): 반의어.
❌ ③ compete with(~와 경쟁하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: complement = 보완하다, 어울리다. compliment(칭찬)과 혼동 주의.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this <u>urban</u> landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'urban'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② rural: urban의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① industrial(산업의): 다른 개념.
❌ ③ commercial(상업의): 다른 개념.
❌ ④ residential(주거의): 다른 개념.
det.tip: urban(도시의) ↔ rural(시골의). 시험 빈출 반의어 쌍.

questions.passage: They also clean the air because their plants give off oxygen and <u>absorb</u> air pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'absorb'와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① emit: absorb의 반의어.
❌ ② attract(끌어당기다): 유사하지만 반의어 아님.
❌ ③ collect(수집하다): 다른 개념.
❌ ④ consume(소비하다): 유사하지만 반의어 아님.
det.tip: absorb(흡수) ↔ emit(방출). give off ≈ emit.

questions.passage:
(A) In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is <u>covered</u> in concrete.

(B) It has a span of 3.6 km and <u>covers</u> an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'covered/covers'가 (A)와 (B)에서 각각 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ (A) 덮여 있다 — (B) 차지하다: (A) 물리적으로 덮힘, (B) 면적을 차지함.
❌ ① 둘 다 '덮여 있다': (B)는 면적 차지.
❌ ② 둘 다 '차지하다': (A)는 콘크리트로 덮힘.
❌ ③ 순서 뒤바뀜.
det.tip: cover: ① 덮다(물리적) ② 차지하다(면적) ③ 다루다(주제). 문맥 구분.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to grow plants or crops by preparing and using land for them"

det.korean: '식물이나 작물을 기르기 위해 땅을 준비하고 사용하다' = cultivate(재배하다).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ cultivate: grow plants by preparing land = 재배하다.
❌ ① harvest(수확하다): 기르는 것이 아니라 거두는 것.
❌ ② irrigate(관개하다): 물을 공급하는 것.
❌ ④ decorate(장식하다): 기르는 것이 아님.
det.tip: cultivate = 재배하다, 경작하다. cultivation(재배/경작).

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been __________ (official) recognized as the largest of its kind.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞는 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ officially: recognized(동사)를 수식하는 부사 필요.
❌ official: 형용사는 동사 수식 불가.
det.tip: 형용사 → 부사: official(공식적인) → officially(공식적으로). -ly 변환.

questions.passage: It also possesses an impressive variety of flowers, with a total of 192 different plant species. The beauty of the rooftop garden changes with each __________ (pass) season, presenting visitors with seasonal flowers and plants, and captivating views to enjoy. The place is free to visit, and everyone is welcome to enjoy the beautiful landscape.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞는 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ passing: 'each passing season' — 현재분사가 명사 수식.
❌ passed: '지나간(과거)'보다 '지나가는(현재진행)' 뉘앙스.
det.tip: passing(지나가는): 현재분사 형용사 용법. each passing day/season = 하루하루/계절마다.

questions.passage: In the city, where people and buildings crowd together, much of the land is covered in concrete. In this urban landscape, rooftop gardens provide a natural oasis. These gardens are for cultivating plants on building roofs, and they offer numerous benefits. They help reduce energy consumption for heating and cooling. They also clean the air because their plants __________ and absorb air pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 식물이 산소를 내뿜고(give off oxygen) 오염물질을 흡수한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② give off oxygen: 원문 일치. 공기 정화 = 산소 배출 + 오염물질 흡수.
❌ ① consume carbon dioxide: 관련은 있지만 원문과 다름.
❌ ③ produce pollutants: 정화와 반대.
❌ ④ block sunlight: 공기 정화와 무관.
det.tip: give off = emit(방출하다). give off oxygen = 산소를 내뿜다.

questions.passage: One remarkable example of a rooftop garden is found at the Government Complex Sejong, which has been officially recognized as the largest of its kind. It has a span of 3.6 km and covers an area of 79,194 m², spread across fifteen connected buildings. The ground is covered in basalt, creating a natural drainage effect. In the garden, speakers for announcements are made to look like rocks to __________, creating a beautiful atmosphere.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① complement the plants: 바위 모양으로 식물과 어울리도록.
❌ ② amplify the sound: 소리 증폭은 아름다운 분위기와 무관.
❌ ③ replace the vegetation: 식물을 대체하는 것이 아님.
❌ ④ contrast with nature: 자연과 대비가 아니라 조화.
det.tip: complement(보완하다): 서로 어울려 완성도를 높이다.
